scenes.tts: If a neuron survives, does it innervate its target normally?
scenes.visual: Title card: Same Factor, Second Job. A surviving neuron and a target with a question mark.
scenes.narration: If a neuron survives, does it innervate its target normally?

scenes.tts: Go back to the mice lacking both Bax and N G F. Their sympathetic neurons survive.
scenes.caption: Go back to the mice lacking both Bax and NGF. Their sympathetic neurons survive.
scenes.visual: The double-null ganglion, full of surviving neurons.
scenes.narration: Go back to the mice lacking both Bax and NGF. Their sympathetic neurons survive.

scenes.tts: Now look at their targets at birth.
scenes.visual: A body map with three targets outlined: salivary glands, heart, trachea.
scenes.narration: Now look at their targets at birth.

scenes.tts: Innervation is missing from some targets, such as the salivary glands.
scenes.visual: The salivary glands stay bare.
scenes.narration: Innervation is missing from some targets, such as the salivary glands.

scenes.tts: It is greatly reduced in others, such as the heart. A few, such as the trachea, are near normal.
scenes.visual: The heart shows thin fibres; the trachea is nearly fully covered.
scenes.narration: It is greatly reduced in others, such as the heart. A few, such as the trachea, are near normal.

scenes.tts: So survival does not mean normal innervation.
scenes.visual: A card: survival is not innervation.
scenes.narration: So survival does not mean normal innervation.

scenes.tts: Within a target, N G F helps axons grow and branch.
scenes.caption: Within a target, NGF helps axons grow and branch.
scenes.visual: An axon tip in an NGF patch inside the target grows and sprouts branches.
scenes.narration: Within a target, NGF helps axons grow and branch.

scenes.tts: So the factor that decides who lives also helps decide how much target each survivor covers.
scenes.visual: Surviving axons spread across a target; coverage shaded.
scenes.narration: So the factor that decides who lives also helps decide how much target each survivor covers.

scenes.tts: The broader task is called systems matching.
scenes.visual: Label: systems matching.
scenes.narration: The broader task is called systems matching.

scenes.tts: Each target gets a fitting number of neurons, amount of innervation, synapses and dendrite shapes. N G F acts on several.
scenes.caption: Each target gets a fitting number of neurons, amount of innervation, synapses and dendrite shapes. NGF acts on several.
scenes.visual: Four dials labelled neurons, innervation, synapses, dendrites; NGF arrows reach several.
scenes.narration: Each target gets a fitting number of neurons, amount of innervation, synapses and dendrite shapes. NGF acts on several.

scenes.tts: Now a different system, and a different variable. Chick motor neurons, and muscle activity.
scenes.visual: Scene changes to a chick embryo spinal cord with motor axons to a limb muscle.
scenes.narration: Now a different system, and a different variable. Chick motor neurons, and muscle activity.

scenes.tts: Curare blocks the acetylcholine receptors of muscle. The muscle stops responding to its nerve.
scenes.visual: Curare molecules sit in muscle acetylcholine receptors; the muscle goes still.
scenes.narration: Curare blocks the acetylcholine receptors of muscle. The muscle stops responding to its nerve.

scenes.tts: Robert Pittman and Ronald Oppenheim gave curare to chick embryos during the period of motor neuron death.
scenes.visual: On screen: Pittman and Oppenheim. A curare drop onto a chick embryo.
scenes.narration: Robert Pittman and Ronald Oppenheim gave curare to chick embryos during the period of motor neuron death.

scenes.tts: If active connections help an axon win, what should paralysis do to motor neuron death?
scenes.visual: On screen: more death or less? Pause and predict.
scenes.narration: If active connections help an axon win, what should paralysis do to motor neuron death?

scenes.tts: You might expect more death. Instead, fewer motor neurons died.
scenes.visual: Motor neuron counts: treated embryos higher than controls.
scenes.narration: You might expect more death. Instead, fewer motor neurons died.

scenes.tts: That looked like a contradiction. Silencing the connection saved neurons.
scenes.visual: A card: silence saved neurons.
scenes.narration: That looked like a contradiction. Silencing the connection saved neurons.

scenes.tts: The usual explanations are interpretations, so hold them loosely.
scenes.visual: Label: interpretations, held loosely.
scenes.narration: The usual explanations are interpretations, so hold them loosely.

scenes.tts: The most common reading is that paralysed muscle may allow more nerve branching and more synapses.
scenes.visual: Label: possible explanation. Motor axons might branch more and form more synapses on a still muscle.
scenes.narration: The most common reading is that paralysed muscle may allow more nerve branching and more synapses.

scenes.tts: That would give each motor neuron more access to trophic support.
scenes.visual: More branches reach more support, shown as small dots.
scenes.narration: That would give each motor neuron more access to trophic support.

scenes.tts: Note that chick motor neurons do not depend on N G F. They draw on several factors at once.
scenes.caption: Note that chick motor neurons do not depend on NGF. They draw on several factors at once.
scenes.visual: Several differently coloured factor dots around the motor neurons; NGF crossed out.
scenes.narration: Note that chick motor neurons do not depend on NGF. They draw on several factors at once.

scenes.tts: In other systems, activity helps a winner. Active synapses can release more B D N F.
scenes.caption: In other systems, activity helps a winner. Active synapses can release more BDNF.
scenes.visual: An active synapse releasing BDNF dots.
scenes.narration: In other systems, activity helps a winner. Active synapses can release more BDNF.

scenes.tts: Activity in the muscle and activity in the competing neurons are different variables. The results need not conflict.
scenes.visual: Two separate dials: muscle activity and neuron activity.
scenes.narration: Activity in the muscle and activity in the competing neurons are different variables. The results need not conflict.

scenes.tts: So here is the rule once more. The target sets how many. The neurons decide which.
scenes.visual: The guiding-rule card returns.
scenes.narration: So here is the rule once more. The target sets how many. The neurons decide which.

scenes.tts: In the published model, a lead grows because N G F raises Track A and lengthens its signal.
scenes.caption: In the published model, a lead grows because NGF raises TrkA and lengthens its signal.
scenes.visual: Two loops on one neuron: receptor level and signal duration.
scenes.narration: In the published model, a lead grows because NGF raises TrkA and lengthens its signal.

scenes.tts: Punishment through p seventy five makes the losers die sooner.
scenes.caption: Punishment through p75 makes the losers die sooner.
scenes.visual: A weak neighbour with p75 fades faster.
scenes.narration: Punishment through p75 makes the losers die sooner.

scenes.tts: The rule is scoped to mouse sympathetic neurons. Chick motor neurons need their own account.
scenes.visual: Scope label beside the card.
scenes.narration: The rule is scoped to mouse sympathetic neurons. Chick motor neurons need their own account.

scenes.tts: Takeaway. N G F supply sets how many sympathetic neurons survive, the neurons' own feedback decides which, and N G F also shapes how much of many targets they cover. Muscle activity is a different variable, in a different system.
scenes.caption: Takeaway. NGF supply sets how many sympathetic neurons survive, the neurons' own feedback decides which, and NGF also shapes how much of many targets they cover. Muscle activity is a different variable, in a different system.
scenes.visual: End card: NGF supply sets how many; feedback decides which; NGF shapes coverage of many targets. Muscle activity: a different variable, a different system.
scenes.narration: Takeaway. NGF supply sets how many sympathetic neurons survive, the neurons' own feedback decides which, and NGF also shapes how much of many targets they cover. Muscle activity is a different variable, in a different system.
